newsitem.title: USA: Wendy's, Exxon open Dallas location.
newsitem.headline: Wendy's, Exxon open Dallas location.

text.p: Wendy's International Inc said its first Dallas, Texas, location combining a Wendy's restaurant, a convenience store, and an Exxon Corp motor fuel facility opened Monday.
A second location will open in late October, Wendy's said.

While several combined Wendy's-Exxon retail locations are in operation across the U.S., the new Dallas area facilities are the first in the nation designed and constructed by the respective parent companies.
Both locations feature a Wendy's restaurant with a complete menu, a Tiger Mart store offering convenience products, an Exxon motor fuel facility, and a car wash.
The new restaurants are operated by Wendy's, with the Tiger Marts, adjacent motor fuel facilities and car washes operated by Exxon. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
